title: Shipping & returns
content:
Shipping


As soon as the order shipment confirmation has been sent in accordance with the GTC, HMD DISTRIBUTION undertakes to deliver the ordered products to the delivery address indicated when the order was placed.

Any anomaly relating to the delivery (damage, product missing compared to the delivery note, damaged parcel, broken products, etc.) must be noted upon delivery and after opening the parcel in the presence of the carrier, and must imperatively be indicated on the delivery note in the form of "handwritten reservations", accompanied by the customer's signature.

Delivery is made by parcel, by post or through a transport company mandated by us. Should we, however, be unable to honour the announced delivery time, for any reason whatsoever, HMD DISTRIBUTION will refund the order no later than 1 month following the order date.

Delivery times are generally between 2 and 10 working days. You may not claim any damages as a result of the failure to deliver within the planned time.

You will be informed of any delivery restrictions/constraints no later than the beginning of the ordering process.

Any claims relating to a delivery error and/or non-conformity of the products in nature or in quality compared to the information shown on the order form must be notified to HMD DISTRIBUTION (see contact details indicated in the introduction to these GTC or by email: sales@hyaluronicfillermarket.com) within 2 working days of receipt of the products, failing which the right to claim shall cease to be acquired.

Right of withdrawal and return

You have the right to withdraw or to return your order within 14 working days in order to return, at your own expense, the products that do not suit you.

To exercise the right of withdrawal and return, you must notify us of your decision to withdraw and return from this contract by means of a declaration to HMD DISTRIBUTION (see contact details indicated in the introduction to these GTC or by email: sales@hyaluronicfillermarket.com).

To benefit from the right of withdrawal and return, the products must not have been opened, damaged or have had their original packaging deteriorated.
We also remind you that class 3 medical devices can neither be returned nor refunded.

In the event of withdrawal on your part from these terms, we will refund the amount paid when you placed your order within a maximum period of one month. We will make the refund using the same means of payment as the one you used for the initial transaction, unless otherwise agreed between the parties on another means of payment. Incoterm EXW - Sales outside Europe: For any sale outside European territory, the products are sold under the Incoterm EXW (Ex Works). Under this Incoterm, the Seller is not responsible for the formalities relating to exportation, nor for the penalties, taxes, customs fees or other associated costs. The Seller may, to facilitate the process, organise the transport of the goods outside its premises by mandating a carrier under EXW, acting explicitly in the name and on behalf of the Customer. By accepting these GTC, the Customer acknowledges that the carrier acts under its sole responsibility and that, due to the Incoterm EXW, the Seller is released from all responsibility once the goods have been handed over to the carrier. Choice of carrier by the Customer: The Customer is free to mandate a carrier of its choice for the collection of the goods at our premises. It is the Customer's responsibility to inform the Seller of this decision and to provide all the details necessary for organising the collection of the goods within an appropriate time before the planned collection date. Responsibilities during transport: The Customer is responsible for ensuring that the mandated carrier complies with the appropriate transport conditions and the regulations applicable to the transport of the goods concerned. Under the Incoterm EXW, the Seller is not responsible for damage, loss or delays occurring after the products have been handed over to the carrier designated by the Customer, nor for additional costs such as customs fees, taxes or penalties that may be imposed after this handover. .
